Stats f32 accumulation fingerprint
checks.summary: per-episode stats carry naive float32 accumulation (10 episode(s))

findings.message: per-episode stats reproduce naive float32 accumulation bitwise (10 sampled episode(s), observation.state dims [0, 1], action dims [0, 1]): the converter's stats are accumulation-rounded, not data-exact; constant channels get a fabricated std and a DC-offset mean
